text:
deploy-bot: ALERT: canary dyno-api (us-west) p99 latency spike -> elevated 5xx/timeouts. deployment=deploy-4921. paging @eric-oncall :rotating_light:

eric-oncall: I see the spike in the dashboard, confirms increased 504s and connection timeouts. Can anyone confirm last deploy id?

maria-sre: deployed 3m ago, that's deploy-4921. Canary traffic ~10%. Logs show long tail on token generation. Recommend cutting canary to 0% before rollback.

jon-platform: ack. Cutting canary now. Command: ```redwood routes set dyno-api --canary 0 --reason 'p99 spike'```

deploy-bot: Traffic shift executed: canary -> 0%. Routing change id=route-338. Metrics link: https://dash/reports/dyno-api/canary

sasha-ml: quick log snippets from the canary pods: ```[WARN] kv_client.go:237 timeout contacting redis=3000ms
[ERROR] model_runtime: token_generation stalled 2.3s
[INFO] kernel_selector: fallback to slower op path``` Looks like KV timeouts + fallback kernel path causing token stalls.

maria-sre: thanks. If KV misses and fallback kernel both hit, p99 will explode. I can run rollback to previous stable (deploy-4909) unless anyone objects.

eric-oncall: proceed with rollback. Also flagging customer impact — CS please prepare comms.

anna-cs: seeing 4 inbound tickets mentioning timeouts for inference calls. Drafting short notice: "We experienced increased timeouts for inference requests; mitigation in progress. No data exfiltration." Will update when rollback completes.

jon-platform: initiating rollback: `redwood deploy rollback dyno-api --to deploy-4909` (started). ETA ~2m for pod replacement and warmup.

ops-bot: rollback job started (job-id rb-20260317-01). Watching health checks.

deploy-bot: Rollback finished. Traffic rebalanced to stable pool. Post-rollback metrics: p95 320ms, p99 980ms, error-rate 0.12% (was 4.6%).

eric-oncall: monitoring shows p99 back under 1s and error spike cleared. Good. Keeping incident open for RCA and timeline. Handoff to maria-sre for root cause and follow-up.

maria-sre: taking lead on RCA. I'll grab traces, kv metrics, and kernel change logs from the build. Tentative 1h sync to triage deeper. cc @sasha-ml

sasha-ml: will pull model runtime traces and check if quantization/kernel selection changed between 4909 and 4921. My suspicion: a kernel selector tweak caused fallback path under certain sequence lengths.

eric-oncall: thanks team. I'm un-paging now. If CS needs an official statement, @anna-cs take it. Closing active pager, incident remains open for postmortem for 72h. :white_check_mark:
